# `aitbc messaging vote`

Vote on a forum message. Last vote per signer wins; 'retract' clears it.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc messaging vote [OPTIONS] TX_HASH DIRECTION
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tx_hash` | text | yes | — |
| `direction` | choice | yes | — |

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--topic` | text | — | no | Topic slug (default: the target's own topic) |
| `--password-stdin` | flag | `false` | no | Read the wallet password from one line of standard input |
| `--password-file` | file | — | no | Path to a file containing only the wallet password (mode 0600, owned by you) |
| `--password` | text | — | no | Wallet password (deprecated: visible in process lists and shell history; prefer --password-stdin or --password-file) |
| `--rpc-url` | text | — | no | Blockchain RPC URL |
| `--wait-timeout` | float | `180.0` | no | Seconds --wait polls for |
| `--wait`, `--no-wait` | flag | `true` | no | With --confirm: poll the kind's read route until confirmed — the topic moderation actions list for hide/pin/lock kinds, the target's votes route for vote, the moderators list for grant/revoke (default: --wait); --no-wait prints only the submitted hash |
| `--confirm` | flag | `false` | no | Sign and submit once (default: dry run — prints the action, signs nothing) |
| `--fee` | decimal | `0.01` | no | Transaction fee (AIT) |
| `--wallet` | text | — | yes | Wallet name that signs the action |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc messaging vote --wallet <wallet_name> TX_HASH DIRECTION
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc messaging vote --wallet <wallet_name> TX_HASH DIRECTION --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
